deviations: Client template is a folder inside Master Control Base, not a separate base.
TEMPLATE_EXECUTIVE_WORKSPACE_BASE_ID is blank — cloning the whole Master Control base would expose private tables.
Email and URL fields are singleLineText with showAs=email/url.
Teable creates reciprocal backlink fields for two-way links.
No webhook or external workflow was deployed by Teable prep.
apiConstraints: Provision via POST /api/base/duplicate with fromBaseId=master, nodes=[templateFolderId], spaceId=TEABLE_SPACE_ID, withRecords=true.
Do not clone the entire Master Control base.
After duplicate, discover client table IDs by stable table names; do not reuse template table IDs from this manifest.
Write link fields with record IDs; use typecast for selects/dates/links; ISO 8601 timestamps (display TZ America/Los_Angeles).
Upload attachments first, then write returned tokens to attachment fields.
Keep API keys in Cloudflare secrets — never Global_System_Variables.

pending.TEABLE_SPACE_ID: REQUIRED — space that receives per-client bases
